{{Quote|I am Glort. Hutt Cartel pays me spice to bash people.|Glort|<ref name="TOR:BaBB" />}}
'''Glort''' was a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I hear that Republic experiments on hungry creatures. Big monsters, armored hides, giant fangs. Republic is putting machines in the beasts. Electrical re--repulses? Something to control them.|Glort|<ref name="TOR:BaBB" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]], he discovered that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] conducted experiments on monstrous creatures, effectively turning them into weapons. He tasked an Imperial spacer to kill the Shaclaw Breeders in the [[hidden Republic lab]].<ref name="TOR:BaBB" />
